title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
abstract: arXiv:2610.40589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. translated_title: 面向固态量子自旋自主实验研究的协作式AI智能体
translated_abstract: 自主研究实验室可以开展一项完整的研究工作，从提出问题到准备手稿。人工智能（AI）为实现这一目标提供了一条途径。近期的AI系统承担了多种研究角色，但可能会得出证据不支持的结论。在此，我们展示了一个自主研究实验室，其中基于大语言模型的智能体能够相互评估彼此的工作，并可以停止或重新定向研究。它们可以生成和否决研究问题，要求进行独立的理论验证，并开展旨在挑战自身主张的实验。我们通过研究金刚石中的量子自旋系综来展示这些能力。智能体推导出了预测特定微波脉冲序列族响应所需的最少数量的校准设置。他们通过计算验证了该结果，并设计实验以区分相互竞争的预测。最初的实验……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由基于大语言模型的协作式AI智能体组成的自主研究实验室，智能体通过相互审查、质疑研究问题、进行理论验证和设计挑战性实验来保障结论的可靠性，并以金刚石量子自旋系综研究为例演示了这一系统。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an autonomous research laboratory where collaborative LLM-based AI agents mutually assess each other's work, question research problems, require theoretical checks, and design challenging experiments to ensure reliable conclusions, demonstrated through investigations of quantum spin ensembles in diamond.
